known_gaps_note: MarkupSafe's C accelerator (_speedups.c, compiled by build_ext into _speedups.cpython-*.so) is outside discover()'s static scope by design -- it only models build_py's file-copying, never runs a compiler. Both the C source and the compiled extension ship in the published wheel; neither is reachable via package_data/MANIFEST.in-style static analysis the way _speedups.pyi (a plain type stub) is.
